entities.name: Louis A. Johnson
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Louis Arthur Johnson was an American politician and attorney who served as the second United States secretary of defense from 1949 to 1950. He was the assistant secretary of war from 1937 to 1940 and the 15th national commander of the American Legion from 1932 to 1933.
